request.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Launch a Flex Template job in a specific location

description.content: Launches a Dataflow job from a Flex Template in the specified project and regional location. Flex Templates package the pipeline code in a Docker container and support dynamic pipeline configuration at launch time.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.
(Required) The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

response.name: Successful response containing the launched job details.
